title: Mixed Event — Stream With Friends♡ Wedding Live! — Episode6 Understudy Idol

meta.Event Outline: Minori has started doing solo walking-tour streams as part of MORE MORE JUMP!'s activities. One day, she follows a viewer's recommendation to check out the Phoenix Bridal Fair!

rows.Line: Rehearsal Room

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line: <Okay, we'll wait for you to resume!>

rows.Speaker: Okamura
rows.Line:
Okay, it's just a sprain...
I'm just glad that it wasn't anything more serious.

rows.Speaker: Cast Member
rows.Line: I'm so sorry. I know my timing couldn't have been worse...

rows.Speaker: Okamura
rows.Line:
We can't change what's happened.
For now, you need to rest at the first aid station. We'll take care of things here.

rows.Speaker: Cast Member
rows.Line: Okay, thank you...
se_walk_women_005_1

rows.Speaker: Okamura
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
So I say, but...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: S-Sorry, but what do we do about the last section? Without her...

rows.Speaker: Okamura
rows.Line: We have no choice but to change it...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
S-Sorry to interrupt!
But what do you mean you have to change it?! Can't someone replace her?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: She was supposed to sing and dance as the live house wedding angel during the final scene. Her replacement would have to be able to do both at the same time...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: A few of the other cast members have dance experience, but doing it while singing would be too much...

rows.Speaker: Okamura
rows.Line: Not to mention, they each have their own roles to play already.

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line:
Mr. Okamura!
She said she can probably still sing! What if we just didn't have her dance?

rows.Speaker: Okamura
rows.Line: At the moment, that's our most realistic option... But taking out that dance routine hurts.

rows.Speaker: Okamura
rows.Line: Especially since our heroine is supposed to make the decision to have a wedding after seeing her performance.

rows.Speaker: Okamura
rows.Line: It's going to be hard for this angel to stand out from the others if she doesn't dance. It's meant to draw the audience in too...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Okamura
rows.Line: However, since we don't have a viable replacement, we're left with no choice. Let's prepare to have her just sing...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: B-But...!

rows.Speaker: Okamura
rows.Line: I understand how you feel, but we just don't have time. We have to make the most of every second we have left and get ready.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Is this really the way to go...?)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I mean, they all worked so hard...)

rows.Speaker: Okamura
rows.Line: But I fear that some of them will look back in regret by the time they've turned my age. That they missed an opportunity to share their happiness with others...

rows.Speaker: Okamura
rows.Line: Which is why I want us to show just how much fun weddings are. So, Ms. Kusanagi, let's do our best today.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (They have a message they want to send. They want people to hear it. They worked really hard just for this day.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (But if they go through with this, the audience might not fully understand what they're trying to do...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Isn't there anything we can do?)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Excuse me!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Would it be possible for me to take her place?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
What...?!
You, Hanasato?!

rows.Speaker: Okamura
rows.Line: I appreciate the offer, but I doubt you have the time to...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I've never performed in a show like this before, but I can sing and dance!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I practice doing both every day. Every single day. Because I'm an idol!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Okamura
rows.Line:
...
Yes, I see...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Obviously, I probably won't be able to match what your actual live house angel can do...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But I'd like to use every second that we have left to take on this challenge! And if I can't learn it in time...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I-If I can't learn it in time...
I... Uhh... W-Won't serve as her replacement!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But I know you, the staff and the cast all worked really hard just for this day.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So, I don't want to just stand by and let your wonderful message go unheard.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Also, I'm sure the audience is really looking forward to seeing this show! Which is why I want to help, if I can!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hanasato...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Give her a chance, Mr. Okamura! I beg you!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm sure she'll see this through!

rows.Speaker: Okamura
rows.Line: I'm here as a professional. I won't put on anything less than the very best.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Okamura
rows.Line: Which is why...

rows.Speaker: Okamura
rows.Line: We're going to run a final check twenty minutes before the curtains go up. If I feel that you're not up for it, then we'll go with our original angel just singing.

rows.Speaker: Okamura
rows.Line: That's the best I can do for you. Are you willing to accept those terms?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
...!
Yes, of course!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Th-Thank you very much...

rows.Speaker: Okamura
rows.Line: No, I should be the one thanking you two.

rows.Speaker: Okamura
rows.Line: Anyway, let's start practicing right away.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay!
se_walk_men_005_1

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Th-Thank goodness...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thank you so much, Hanasato...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait a second. What about your stream?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, my viewers are gonna have to be patient... But I'm sure they'll understand!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Let's make this show a big success!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Alright, I'll be over there practicing!
Let's both do our best!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
She really is an incredible person.
I mean, she basically jumped straight into the deep end...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Hehe. She seems like a lovely girl♪>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
L-Luka...?!
Did you hear all of that just now?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Yes, from inside your pocket♪>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Her name is Hanasato, yes?
Even from where I was, I could tell that she's a very honest and hardworking girl.>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, and what she's doing is pretty cool...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Yes, it is♪ And you two make for such wonderful friends♪>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Because you're both doing your best for the sake of others. You're trying to make them smile. Isn't that right?>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Thanks...
I really appreciate you saying that.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Now then...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I need to do my best to give Hanasato all the support I can.

rows.Speaker: Okamura
rows.Line: One, two, three, four!

rows.Speaker: Okamura
rows.Line:
Stop there!
Your dancing isn't bad, but this is musical theater. I need you to exaggerate each move more than you normally do as an idol! Use your whole body!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: G-Got it!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, keep in mind it'll be harder to stay on pitch! Try to focus more on your diaphragm than usual.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
O-Okay...!
Thanks, Nene!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Please let me try that again!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huff... Huff... Huff...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: H-How was that?!

rows.Speaker: Okamura
rows.Line: That should do just fine.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
...!
Does that mean...?!

rows.Speaker: Okamura
rows.Line: Yes. We've found our replacement angel, Ms. Hanasato.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Y-Yes!
Thank goodness!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah...
Thank goodness.

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: This is it, everyone! We need you all on standby!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh...!
It's about to start already!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah.
So...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Let's go out there and do our best, Hanasato!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, but before we go!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I want everyone to see this, so mind if I set up my phone somewhere off to one side of the stage?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah, sure!
Lemme just get permission for you first.
